verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's core proxy is API-first (OpenAI-compatible completion endpoint), and key admin features like virtual keys, budgets, teams, and cost tracking are documented as configurable via API/config (docs-7,8,25,26), suggesting API access to most admin functions. However, evidence shows some flows (e.g., MCP server setup) are described specifically via the UI (docs-27), and no OpenAPI/swagger spec was discoverable (probe-3), leaving unclear whether full UI-to-API parity is guaranteed.
